corrections.baseline: Previously published GPU Huffman decoders (unnamed in the abstract summaries; the IPDPS 2022 artifact codyjrivera/ipdps22-opthuffdec benchmarks this decoder alongside CUHD's self-synchronization decoder), an unnamed CPU Huffman implementation, and the same GPU decoder without a gap array
corrections.claimed_speedup: Snippet only (WebSearch summaries of the ICPP 2020 abstract): GPU Huffman decoding 1.26x-2.63x faster (encoding 2.87x-7.70x faster) than previously presented GPU Huffman decoding (encoding); GPU decoding 35.2x-43.3x faster than CPU implementations; with a gap array attached, decoding is a further 1.67x-6450x faster than without one.

The 6450x upper bound compares against decoding without a gap array, i.e. the decoder's own fallback.
